::: {#exm-hers-r-squared}
#### $R^2$ for the regression of glucose on BMI in HERS

For the fit in @exm-hers-slr,
$R^2$ computed from @def-r-squared,
the square of the Pearson correlation, and `lm()`'s value agree:

```{r}
fit <- lm(glucose ~ BMI, data = hers)
y <- fit$model$glucose
c(
  r_squared = 1 - sum(residuals(fit)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2),
  cor_squared = cor(fit$model$BMI, y)^2,
  lm = summary(fit)$r.squared
)
```

BMI accounts for only about
`r round(100 * summary(lm(glucose ~ BMI, data = hers))$r.squared)`% of the
variation in baseline fasting glucose.
:::
